concepts.name: Modern Premium Coffee
concepts.big_idea: Create a modern premium coffee campaign with an elegant look.
concepts.creative_tension: Modern and beautiful yet simple but elegant.
concepts.visual_metaphor: A clean and elegant premium lifestyle scene that is visually appealing.
concepts.why: It will be eye-catching design that feels stylish and sophisticated.
concepts.visual_world: A sleek and modern aesthetic and engaging atmosphere with a premium feel.
concepts.risk: Reads as quiet and may lose against louder promotional posts in a scroll.

concepts.name: Elegant Vibes
concepts.big_idea: A unique and modern look that feels fresh and modern for the brand.
concepts.visual_metaphor: Beautiful and inviting imagery with stunning visuals.
concepts.why: It captures attention and stands out from the crowd.
concepts.visual_world: A warm and inviting atmosphere with a luxury feel.
concepts.risk: Requires real people on the day and cannot be shot before opening.
